cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my coat on like you. Nice and warm for a talk. You said work kept you till six; why's this taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm going for the last bus. I'll explain tomorrow.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Coats ready, then. I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five and stopped somewhere before coming home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sit down and tell me where. I'll drive you after you've explained that stop.

reason: Replace stock confidence with a mistaken copied practical cue and a confident adaptation; maintain exact secrecy, explanation, concealment-apology, endorsement, or delegated-follow-up pursuit.
